summary: Missile Command entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Missile Command
entries.definitive_edition: Original arcade version via Atari collection; original cabinet if control authenticity is required

emulation.notes: MAME/original cabinet only for comparison if official route is unavailable.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade cabinet; practical ceiling is official Atari collection capture

primary.platform: Windows PC / Atari 50 or Atari Vault collection
primary.version: Original arcade Missile Command through current Atari collection route
primary.why: Missile Command is an Atari arcade game built around trackball play. Original arcade hardware is the authenticity reference, but Atari's current/legacy PC collections are the practical official capture route for the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Use Atari 50 or an owned Atari collection containing the arcade original. Record collection/version, arcade vs home version, input device/trackball state, difficulty, starting cities/settings, save/rewind/assist use, score route, and whether original cabinet footage was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if exact arcade control fidelity matters.
secondary.why: Modern collections are easier to capture, but original trackball hardware is the reference.
The arcade game is the primary version identity.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record arcade/home variant and input device; do not substitute Missile Command: Recharged for the 1980 arcade game.
